title: SkZ: Enhance
description: A lightweight client-side modpack. Features optimization mods and gameplay enhancements.
body:
![previev](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b1ad7a865e32db658524f799962653256305d141.png)
### Enhance is a Minecraft modpack that upgrades the game's visuals and audio while adding subtle tweaks to make the gameplay feel fresh, polished, and more beautiful.

<details>
<summary>Key Features</summary>

**Soundscape**
- The modpack features overhauled game audio. This includes revamped ambient sounds and cave echoes, along with new sound effects for inventory interactions, hotbar scrolling, chat typing, and block selection.

**Optimization**
- Built on a Sodium-based foundation, the pack offers solid base optimization. While it isn't a dedicated "performance-only" pack, the underlying framework ensures a smooth and stable experience.

**Animations**
- Player animations have been extensively updated. You will notice more fluid and realistic movements in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

**Pre-configured Settings**
- The pack comes with pre-configured audio levels and a curated resource pack order. Most of the legwork is done for you, though further fine-tuning is left to your personal preference.

**Visuals & Shaders**
- Visual mods bring a more polished look to the world. Weather effects like rain and snow have been reworked to be more concise and realistic. Numerous "quality-of-life" visual tweaks emphasize the game's beauty without straying too far from its core. Additionally, the pack includes three selected shaders tailored for a range of hardware, from mid-range setups to high-end PCs.
</details>
